note: SH579 — the declared exceptions to 'a red suite is a stop'. A suite that is red either blocks the next commit or has an entry here: dated, time-boxed, and pointing at the open task that removes it. Nothing else. cli/test/red-suites.test.mjs enforces the shape and kills an entry whose task has shipped or whose date has passed, so a forgotten exception goes red instead of quiet. Read docs/agents/build.md before adding one.

exceptions.test: SH747/SH653 the coverage matrix ratchet, SH719 the duplicate-url slug, SH722 a defect that stopped reproducing, SH723 the change-feed row cap
exceptions.why: Five of 119 fail on a clean instance at :2711, and CI has been red on this gate since 2026-08-13 — eight consecutive pushes, with this ledger empty the whole time, which is the state SH579 exists to make impossible. None of the five is a content defect an agent or a curator would meet: SH747 and SH653 are a documentation ratchet whose matrix lives in the vigletdocs repo, so a ship here and a page there are two commits nothing ties together; SH722's own message reports that the defect it describes has stopped reproducing and asks to be deleted; SH719 pins a `duplicate-url` slug against a refusal that now teaches in full prose without it; SH723 is a row-cap assertion on the change feed. Safe to commit over because the product paths they touch all answer correctly when driven by hand — measured, not assumed — and because the alternative is to keep committing over an UNDECLARED red, which is exactly what the last eight pushes did. SH755 is the task that removes it, and it starts with the instrument rather than the five repairs: nothing compares the declared red to the actual red, which is why this went eight pushes without anybody being asked.
